name: Render: Status Card
description: Renders a structured status card with a heading, status badges, optional progress bar, and a body summary. Reusable building block for dashboards and live monitoring.

tasks.description: Render a status card with heading, badges, and optional progress bar.

prompt.template:
Render a status card component using render_ui.

Title: {{title}}
Status: {{status}}
Summary: {{summary}}
Progress: {{progress}}

Build a vertical container with:
1. A text heading (variant: heading) showing the title
2. A horizontal container with badges — one for '{{status}}' (map: ok→success, warn→warning, error→error, info→info, else→neutral) and any extra context badges from the summary
3. If progress is provided and is a number 0-100, add a progress bar (type: bar, value: {{progress}})
4. A text body (variant: body) with the summary

Call render_ui once with this structure. Use animation: fade and position.mode: flow.

Container props to use:
- Outer: layout: vertical, gap: 12, padding: 16, maxWidth: 600
- Badge row: layout: horizontal, gap: 8, naked: true

variables.name: status
variables.description: Status: ok, warn, error, info, or any text
